items.problem: A node of the new scene whose `process_mode` is `PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS` receives `_process` from stage 4, which differs from "does not receive the per-frame engine callbacks or the input callbacks" (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/modules/scene-core.md`, `### scene`). The only stop is `PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED` on the scene holder, and a node with its own mode does not inherit it. `PROCESS_MODE_ALWAYS` is the documented way for a node to run during pause (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:312`). Run path: in a scratch copy, `on_prepare` of `scene_b` added such a node and `on_prepare` waited on a gate; after 3 more frames that node had counted 4 `_process` calls while the scene root had counted 0. The engine mapping (`open-game-works-core/skills/client-core/engines/godot.md:294`) says `_process()` does not run under the holder, so that sentence also needs correcting. The code has been this way since before the range
